name: Drive Downloads Lite
author: Drive Downloads Pro

sections.description:
Sell digital products with WooCommerce and Google Drive, without spending your time copying download links. Drive Downloads Lite makes it easy to connect files and folders stored in Google Drive to WooCommerce products.

Open a product, choose a file or folder from Google Drive, and the plugin adds its link to your WooCommerce downloads. Your files remain in Google Drive, and you stay in control of who can open them.

Make Google Drive downloads easier with Lite

  • Set up products faster. Select existing files and folders or upload new files directly through Google Picker, without copying links by hand.
  • Keep your files in Google Drive. Connect PDFs, templates, ZIPs, videos, and other digital resources to your WooCommerce store.
  • Use the sharing you already have. Lite works with files and folders you’ve made accessible in Google Drive; it doesn’t change their sharing settings.
  • Choose a download name. Set a default for your store or customize it for individual products.
  • Keep your usual WooCommerce workflow. Customers find their purchased downloads in WooCommerce, and shared links open in Google Drive.

Please note: Lite does not make files private for each buyer, create direct file downloads, or automatically grant and remove Google Drive access when an order changes. If you need those features, Drive Downloads Pro is built for that workflow.

Want to offer a better download experience? Meet Drive Downloads Pro

As your store grows, managing shared links and buyer access manually can take more time. Drive Downloads Pro lets you decide how each product is delivered and automates much of the work after a customer orders.

  • Direct downloads: Let buyers download through WooCommerce without sending them to a Google Drive sharing page. Folders can be packaged for download as ZIP files.
  • Private access for each buyer: Give customers access through their own Google account, instead of relying on a shared link.
  • Automatic delivery and access changes: Grant access when an order is completed and remove it when configured order events, such as cancellations or refunds, require it.
  • More ways to deliver: Choose direct download, private Google Drive access, or access through a shared link, with settings that can vary by product.
  • Better support for repeat customers: Handle Google Drive access with supported WooCommerce subscription changes.
  • Less manual work: Manage several Google Drive accounts, select multiple items and keep track of access operations in one place.
  • Clearer customer communication: Send access notifications and let buyers provide the Google account email they want to use, where enabled.

Which version should you choose?

  • Choose Lite if you want a quick way to attach already-shared Google Drive files and folders to WooCommerce products.
  • Choose Pro if you want direct downloads, buyer-specific privacy, automatic access management or multiple delivery options.

Explore Drive Downloads Pro

Getting started

  1. Connect your Google account in the Drive Lite settings.
  2. Open a WooCommerce product and enable downloadable files.
  3. Select Choose from Google Drive to pick an existing item or upload a new file to Google Drive. Files can be uploaded to a folder you choose.
  4. Save the product. WooCommerce will use its Google Drive link for the download. Make sure the file is shared appropriately with customers in Google Drive.

Need help connecting Google? Follow the video setup guide below or see the installation instructions.

Google Drive setup video

External services

This plugin connects your WooCommerce store with Google Drive using your own app in Google Cloud Console.

You will need to:

  • Create a Google Cloud project.
  • Create OAuth 2.0 credentials (Client ID and Client Secret).
  • Create an API key for the Google Picker.
  • Copy the numeric Google Cloud Project number used as the Picker App ID.

These are configured on the plugin settings page, following the documentation provided here:

Documentation

Through your own Google app, the plugin:

  • Lets you sign in with your Google account (OAuth) to link your Drive. New connections use the limited https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file scope recommended for Picker-based file selection.
  • Shows the Google Drive picker so you can choose folders or files.
  • Reads basic information about your Drive user (name, email address and profile photo link).
  • Receives the selected Drive item metadata returned by Google Picker (IDs, names, URLs, MIME types and resource keys when present) so it can insert the correct URL into the WooCommerce download field and show the connection status in the admin.

The plugin does not upload your files to other servers and does not send data to any third party other than Google’s APIs used for this purpose.
The Lite version does not change your Google Drive sharing settings or file contents; it only reads the information needed to build download URLs and display the connection in your dashboard.

Please review Google’s own terms and privacy information here:

  • Google APIs Terms of Service
  • Google Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from “Plugins → Add New”.
  2. Activate the plugin through “Plugins → Installed Plugins”.
  3. Go to the new Drive Lite settings page in the WordPress admin.
  4. In your Google Cloud Console:
    • Enable Google Drive API and Google Picker API.
    • Create an OAuth 2.0 Client (type “Web application”).
    • In Google Auth Platform → Data Access, add https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file. Lite does not need the restricted drive.readonly scope for new connections.
    • Add the plugin’s redirect URL shown on the settings page.
    • Copy the numeric Project number from Google Cloud; Drive Lite uses it as the Google Picker App ID.
    • Create an API key for Google Picker. Restrict it to Google Picker API and Google Drive API.
    • Under HTTP referrers, allow your WordPress site and https://docs.google.com/* because Google Picker runs inside a Google-hosted iframe.
  5. Copy and paste into the plugin settings and save:
    • Client ID
    • Project number (App ID)
    • Client Secret
    • Picker API key
  6. Click Connect with Google and complete the OAuth flow. New connections request the limited drive.file scope recommended for Google Picker workflows.
    • If an existing installation was connected by an older Lite release, Drive Lite keeps that authorization working and shows a one-click reconnect notice so you can migrate to drive.file when convenient.
    • After reconnecting successfully with drive.file, you can remove the old drive.readonly scope from the Google Auth Platform configuration if it is no longer used by another application.
    • If your Google Auth Platform app is External and left in Testing, Google can expire test authorizations and require reconnection; use the appropriate publishing status for a long-running store connection.
  7. Edit a WooCommerce product and enable “Downloadable”.
  8. Go to the Drive Lite tab and use the Choose from Google Drive button to select a folder or file.
  9. Publish or update the product. WooCommerce now uses that Google Drive URL as the download.
sections.faq:
Can I sell Google Drive files and folders through WooCommerce?

Yes. Lite helps you add Google Drive files or folders to downloadable WooCommerce products. Customers use the link provided through WooCommerce, subject to the sharing settings you set in Google Drive.

Does Lite automatically give private access to each customer?

No. Lite connects existing Google Drive links to products; it does not grant or remove access for individual buyers. For private buyer-only access and automatic management after purchases, use Drive Downloads Pro.

Can customers download without opening Google Drive?

Not with Lite. Lite uses the existing Google Drive sharing link. Pro offers direct downloads through WooCommerce for supported files and folders, so customers do not have to visit the Google Drive sharing page.

Are my files stored on my WordPress hosting?

Not with Lite. Your files stay in Google Drive, and the plugin adds their links to WooCommerce products. Pro’s direct-download mode delivers content through your store and can use server resources when processing downloads.

Can I choose whether a file is public or private?

With Lite, you control sharing directly in Google Drive. Buyers can open a link only if its Google Drive sharing settings allow it. Pro adds managed private access for buyers and managed shared-link delivery.

What do I gain by upgrading to Pro?

Pro adds direct downloads, private access for individual customers, automatic access management when configured order states change, support for Google Drive sharing with WooCommerce Subscriptions, multiple Google accounts, and more delivery options per product.

Will I lose my products when switching from Lite to Pro?

Pro can import compatible Lite settings and recognizes existing Lite product download names. Your WooCommerce products and their existing download URLs are not intentionally removed by upgrading. For Pro’s expanded access features, you must connect Google again from the Pro settings. Check the connection before deactivating Lite.

Does the plugin work without WooCommerce?

No. Drive Downloads Lite is built for downloadable products in WooCommerce.

Do I need a Google account?

Yes. You connect your own Google account and follow the guided Google Cloud setup once. See the installation steps and setup video for details.

What information does Lite store?

Lite stores your Google connection settings, the selected file or folder URLs and the optional default download name in WordPress. Sensitive credentials are protected with encryption when supported by the server. Lite does not copy the contents of your Google Drive files to WordPress.

Can I use Lite with a multilingual store or multisite?

Lite includes English, Spanish, French and Portuguese translations. It can run on a WordPress multisite installation, with a separate Google connection for each site.

What about customer privacy?

Lite does not add a buyer-specific Google email field or manage customer permissions. Review your store’s privacy policy and Google’s terms before offering downloads through Google Drive.

2.2.12

  • Prevented the WooCommerce product editor from scrolling when Google Picker opens, including clicks from variation download rows.
  • Preserved the editing position while Google Picker mounts its dialog and returns a selected file or folder.
  • Deferred WooCommerce’s Downloadable checkbox change until a file has been selected, avoiding layout jumps on open.
  • Ignored Google Picker’s intermediate LOADED events rather than treating them as a close action.
  • Kept Google Drive upload, OAuth, selected download links, product settings and HPOS integration unchanged.

2.2.11

  • Added an Upload tab inside Google Picker, allowing authorized users to upload files directly to their Google Drive account and select them for WooCommerce products.
  • Supports choosing the destination folder with Google’s native upload view; files never pass through the WordPress server.
  • The upload tab is available for connections with the drive.file or drive scope. Existing read-only connections keep working and can reconnect to enable uploading.
  • Clarified that uploaded Google Drive files still need appropriate sharing permissions for WooCommerce customers.
  • Preserved existing Google OAuth connections, selection, WooCommerce redirects, product settings and HPOS behavior.

2.2.10

  • Hardened the Google OAuth state with per-request entropy and one-use validation, while accepting short-lived authorization attempts started by older Lite releases.
  • Require a valid Google Cloud project number before enabling Picker with the drive.file scope.
  • Let Google Picker show files and folders shared with the connected account, not only owned/root items.
  • Preserve Google Docs, Sheets and Slides URLs returned by Picker, with strict Google HTTPS URL validation and canonical fallbacks.
  • Prevent incomplete WooCommerce download fields from being treated as valid insertion targets.
  • Maintained existing connected accounts, stored settings, WooCommerce download links, and HPOS integration.

2.2.9

  • Rewrote the public plugin description and FAQs to clarify what Lite delivers and when Pro is useful.
  • Updated the WordPress plugin summary and the Pro upgrade banner with customer-focused wording.
  • Confirmed upgrade guidance against Drive Downloads Pro 2.8.39, including the required Google reconnection for Pro permissions.
  • Refreshed English, Spanish, French and Portuguese interface translations without changing download behavior.

2.2.8

  • Updated the WordPress.org description to reflect the current Lite/Pro delivery options.
  • Clarified direct downloads, private access and Google Drive sharing through Pro.
  • Refreshed the Pro upgrade message and bundled translations.

2.2.7

  • Updated new Google OAuth connections to the least-privilege drive.file scope recommended for Google Picker workflows; existing connections remain active until voluntarily reconnected.
  • Added Google Cloud Project number (App ID) support and passes it to Google Picker with setAppId().
  • Updated API-key guidance for current Google Picker requirements, including https://docs.google.com/* and restricting the key to Google Picker API plus Google Drive API.
  • Preserves Google Picker resourceKey values in generated file and folder links.
  • Hardened Picker access with the dedicated drivdoli_use_picker capability: administrators are enabled by default and Shop Managers can be enabled explicitly.
  • Limited the Picker DOM observer to the WooCommerce product-data area instead of scanning the full WordPress admin page.
  • Fixed per-product download-name inheritance so an empty product field continues to follow the global default.
  • Picker now reads the current per-product download name immediately, including unsaved field changes.
  • Added App ID validation, complete uninstall cleanup for new settings/capabilities, and refreshed Google setup documentation.
  • Verified compatibility with WordPress 7.1.2 and WooCommerce 11.1.2.

2.2.6

  • Verified compatibility with WordPress 7.1.2 and WooCommerce 11.1.2.
  • Hardened product-editor asset loading by using the current admin screen, including new-product screens.
  • Revalidated the classic product editor hooks, Google Drive download redirect filter and HPOS compatibility declaration against WooCommerce 11.1.2.

2.2.5

  • Verified compatibility with WordPress 7.1 and WooCommerce 11.1.
  • Updated plugin compatibility metadata without changing runtime behavior.

2.2.4

  • Declared compatibility with WordPress 7.0 and WooCommerce 11.0.
  • Prevented the Lite runtime from loading when Drive Downloads Pro is already active.

short_description: Connect Google Drive to WooCommerce. Add files and folders to digital products in minutes, without copying links by hand.
